headline: Building the Next Generation of Engineers.
shortDescription: Fostering innovation, collaborative development, and engineering excellence. We build the future, one line of code at a time.
heroDescription: The premier Tech Society of BIT Mesra — fostering innovation, coding excellence, and technical leadership for the next generation of builders and security practitioners.

mission.title: Our Mission
mission.summary: Empowering students to bridge theory and real-world engineering through hands-on workshops, hackathons, open-source collaboration, and peer mentorship.

vision.title: Our Vision
vision.summary: Demystifying technology from kernel to cloud — cultivating a campus culture where curiosity meets raw execution and technical leadership.

story: Founded in 2021 at BIT Mesra Patna Campus, IGNITE started with a focused group of student builders who wanted a space beyond classroom lectures to ship real software, explore cybersecurity, and prototype hardware systems.

Today, IGNITE brings together developers, designers, competitive programmers, and researchers across batches — hosting flagship hackathons like Inginiux and Xordium, technical labs, and collaborative guild projects.

pillars.title: Development & Engineering
pillars.description: Intensive workshops on Web, Cloud, AI, and distributed software systems using modern industry stacks.

pillars.title: Hardware & IoT Systems
pillars.description: Hands-on embedded prototyping with microcontrollers, sensor matrices, Arduino, and edge compute nodes.

pillars.title: Guild & Community
pillars.description: Peer mentorship, tech speaker sessions, inter-collegiate hackathons, and high-impact career pathways.
